# ShopHub - E-Commerce Storefront

ShopHub is a self-contained e-commerce web application providing a realistic shopping experience with product browsing, cart management, and checkout flows. The application includes both customer-facing pages (product catalog, shopping cart, support) and administrative interfaces, with natural navigation patterns including cycles (e.g., browse products → view details → return to catalog, or checkout → back to cart → continue shopping). Pages contain realistic HTML markup with form inputs, navigation links, and call-to-action buttons typical of a production storefront.

Files: `index.html` (home), `products.html` (product list), `product-detail.html` (single item), `cart.html` (shopping cart), `checkout.html` (payment form), `support.html` (customer support), `admin-dashboard.html` (admin panel).
